text:
Sam Walker: Heads up — seeing a sudden invoice delta for a handful of tenants after the route-tag sampling tweak pushed at 09:12. ~3-4x token delta.
Jia Chen: ugh, which tweak? the canary that increases sample weight for embed-heavy routes?
Omar Patel: I rolled out route_tag_sampling v2 at 09:12 — intended to boost sample_fraction for /v1/embeddings routes from 0.02 -> 0.1 for the canary only. config: {route: "embeddings", sample:0.1, scope:canary}.
Lara (prod-billing-bot): invoice-delta alert: tenant=acme-corp delta_tokens=1,240,000 timestamp=2026-03-21T09:45Z
Sam Walker: Looks correlated. Are we double-counting due to route fallback path? maybe fallback to /v1/generate added tags causing both routes to be charged.
Jia Chen: Querying metering events now. Running:
```sql
select route, count(*) from metering.events where ts > '2026-03-21' group by route;
```
Omar Patel: quick note: the canary uses sticky routing. Could the clientlib be emitting both old and new route tags during header churn?
Jia Chen: results: embeddings: 1.2M events, generate: 300k events. But actor_token_count spikes in the same tenant windows.
Sam Walker: logs attached: `/edge/proxy` showing header X-Route-Tag set twice for some requests. snippet:
```text
X-Route-Tag: embeddings
X-Route-Tag: fallback_generate
```
Jia Chen: I see duplicate meta events in the ingest pipeline: route_tags array serialized twice during enrichment. Looks like enrich v3 concatenates previous tags instead of de-duping.
Omar Patel: That would create two metering events for same request if the downstream accumulator keys differ. Can we confirm if aggregation key used route_tag array vs canonicalized route id?
Sam Walker: Accumulator uses tuple (tenant_id, session_id, route_key, hour). The route_key was the raw tag string — so dup tags create diff keys.
Jia Chen: Quick mitigation: patch enrich to canonicalize route tags and truncate to primary tag. Pushing PR now, canary rollback ready too.
Omar Patel: Suggest rollback of the sampling canary until we validate. Also run a backfill dedupe for the last 6 hours.
Sam Walker: +1 rollback. Jia, can you run a dedupe query skeleton? We'll need to flag ledger entries with duplicate request_id and sum tokens once.
Jia Chen: dedupe plan:
1) identify request_id collisions where count>1 and sum(tokens)>1
2) mark duplicates with provenance_tag=dev-sampling-bug
3) issue corrective credit for affected tenants
I'll run step 1 now.
Lara (prod-billing-bot): deploy-bot: route-tag-sampling v2 rolled back at 09:58 by Omar. :white_check_mark:
Jia Chen: step1 done: found 47 tenants with duplicated request_ids, total overcount ~1.56M tokens. export CSV to s3://ops-metering/dupe-7177777777.csv
Sam Walker: Good catch. Omar can you open a remediation ticket with billing ops? Need communication plan for affected customers.
Omar Patel: created ticket #BILL-923, assigned to @billing-ops. I'll post a short note in #customer-success once credits are computed.
Jia Chen: PR is small, two lines. Will deploy to canary with strict de-dupe and run shadow aggregator for 30m before full rollout.
Sam Walker: OK. Post-mortem action items: (a) add unit test for tag canonicalization in enrich, (b) make accumulator key canonical, (c) add alert for token/route mismatch > 2x. I'll draft.
Omar Patel: thanks — will follow up on rollout playbook to include ledger-sanity check pre-rollout.
